neighbours.label: words opening with the letters 'fur' or 'gur', in any language or script (Latin or Cyrillic), including invented names; some rare words where an F or G is followed by an 'l' or 'il' piece also fire; silent for 'ur' after other letters (b, t, n, p, th)
fire: We bought new furniture for the living room last weekend.
The old furnace in the basement finally broke down in January.
Furthermore, the committee rejected the second proposal.
The baby laughed at the gurgling sound of the stream.
He spent ten years studying meditation with a guru in the mountains.
The cat's thick fur kept it warm all winter.
The factory workers were furloughed for three weeks.
She was furious when the train was cancelled again.
